sections.changelog:
Added

  • New "Match words in product data, not the description" option (General tab). A query word counts toward the strictness rule only when it appears in the product name, SKU, attributes, brand or category — not in the long or short description. This stops an unrelated product from satisfying an all-words query just because its marketing text incidentally mentions a model number or a part word (e.g. a used phone whose description says "12 MP camera" and "glass body" surfacing for "iPhone 12 glass"). The description still contributes to ranking. Off by default; recommended for parts and accessories shops.
